title: Recover full eight-board i200 teacher after converter truncation
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The prior eight-board adapter lost its mirror signal because each deep SRP checkpoint was silently truncated to the first 8,388,608 unique keys during conversion; complete sharded conversion will restore board/history coverage and outperform the truncated teacher under the identical conservative dual-mask distillation recipe.
material_change: Reconvert all existing eight-board b8/i200 cap1 SRP and 3BP raw checkpoints with the sharded infoset loader and deployment-semantic raise counts, record skip accounting, validate cross-language parity, then train the same frozen-source H64/source-KL1/L2=.01 dual-mask adapter with board-disjoint splits.
baseline: Truncated eight-board dual-mask H64 epoch3 mirror4096 -0.452 bb/100 CI95 +/-0.864; four-board dual-mask +2.005 +/-0.631 mirror10k but fresh5k -41.98 CI [-84.83,+0.87].

code.provenance_gap: Historical record predates automatic patch/source-manifest capture; the exact dirty worktree cannot be reconstructed post hoc.

notes: Full sharded eight-board teacher is 77.4% larger than the truncated artifact and passes 1.657M-row replay/state/target validation with zero failures. Begin identical H64 dual-mask distillation.

Post-hoc infrastructure repair refreshed verifiable wall-time and artifact-integrity fields. The exact historical dirty-worktree patch/source manifest and placeholder commands cannot be reconstructed without falsifying provenance; the record explicitly preserves that gap.

result.summary: Sharded conversion recovered 722,965 missing rows (+77.4%) and passed complete bridge validation, but both validation-selected epoch2 and fixed-comparison epoch3 were negative versus Standard10 at the 4,096-pair mirror screen.
result.conclusion: The single-Map truncation was real and materially distorted prior datasets, but simply restoring the full eight-board cap1 teacher does not improve internal play under the same H64 dual-mask objective. No Slumbot evaluation is justified.
result.next_step: Train the exact four-board subset from the corrected full conversion with the same dual-mask recipe (boards 0-1 train, 2 validation, 3 test). This isolates whether the old four-board positive mirror signal depended on truncated row ordering/distribution.
